notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.6
notes.content:
Hello heroes! 

We’ve made the following bug fixes and balance updates to Slime Heroes today. We’ve also done a lot more Multiplayer sync fixes between players.

Balance Notes


 Lowered flathead enemies’ attacks by 10%
 Equalized battle dungeon enemies bonus health and damage to 140%

Single Player


 Player couldn’t rotate sometimes after using skills
 The player couldn’t move sometimes after leaving the Orion Menu
 Humming sound effects constantly playing
 Removed an invisible barrier in the Decoy Dungeon
 The level-up system would not allow an upgrade when the shard count is exactly equal to the cost
 Lots of localization fixes for text

Online Multiplayer


 Second-player jitters when using basic and heavy attacks 
 All enemy health bars appear on first player's screen when the second player joins
 Slime jump causes unintended jittering forthe  second player when double jump is enabled
 Enemies are falling through the world sometimes when the second player joins
 Second player dash would not restore sometimes
 The second player dodge recovery accessibility setting wasn’t working
 Ice desync between both players
 Enemies' health bars were not synced up betweenthe  first and second player


See more bugs? Game updates and bug fixes are ongoing, and we’re actively checking bug reports on Bug Report Form

Feel free to join our Discord for more communication and updates!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.4
notes.content:
Hello heroes! 

We’ve made the following bug fixes and balance updates to Slime Heroes today. Including some new features

New Features


 Multiplier numbers are visible for the scale sliders in the player difficulty menu
 Added bug reporting button on the main menu that goes to the Slime Heroes bug reporting page 
 Added a button option for opening directly to the player menu map page


Balance Notes


 Falling into lava applies fire damage
 Ignis attacks hit more frequently
 The projectile/whirlwind skill combo now spawns two projectiles
 Lowered invulnerable window after player receives damage from 0.8 to 0.7
 Whale enemy in desert will more frequently attack 
 The spawn skill dungeon's last couple of puzzles had a polish pass
 Getting to full run speed for player character reduced by 1 second
 Lower energy gain from all weapons by 10%
 Increase the damage on fist weapon by 15%


Single Player


 Frigis sometimes sinks into the ground or disappears into the sky
 Frigis polish pass. Attacks should be more reliable
 Achievements for damage and completing dungeons should be able to be obtained
 All UI should look good on widescreen
 Sound effects system polish. Sounds should be more consistent and go away properly when the volume is muted
 Switching the console type for the gamepad UI should be more accurate to Playstation and Switch button layouts
 The controls menu locked after attempting to remap a button to Menu
 The player gets stuck under the map when leaving the battle dungeon in the snow biome
 Magic stat was updating when changing the damage scale in the player menu
 The player would get stuck after interacting with Frigus
 The gas puzzle in the swamp biome continues to work if the player respawns after attempting it
 Ignis hit checks should be more reliable
 The player would lose a dodge icon if resting at Orion right after dodging
 Lotred grab should be more reliable and not damage players randomly
 Lux will damage players while spinning
 Players fall through enemy blocks while the game is paused
 Ignis pillar attacks launch players high into the air
 Enemy puzzle blocks should spawn more reliably when falling into water
 Lotred spore attack wasn’t spawning 
 Pazmut showing when you will get a new heart is more reliable
 Reflect skill dungeon final fight projectile spawners should work


Online Multiplayer


 The second player randomly gets multiple hearts
 Second player randomly getting shards after resting at Orion
 Second player randomly getting new hat and skill icons popping up after resting at Orion
 The second player should be able to change the sound volume when joining an online game
 Tome is awarded outside of the dungeon instead of being available to pick up before exiting
 The second player will more reliably spawn boss skills
 Half cost return shards button in orion rest menu doesn't destroy the shards on both server and client when server uses the button


See more bugs? Game updates and bug fixes are ongoing, and we’re actively checking bug reports on Bug Report Form

Feel free to join our Discord for more communication and updates!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.2
notes.content:
Hello heroes! 

We’ve made the following bug fixes and some balance updates to the game today. Including some new features

New Features

 Weapon combo customization for basic and heavy attacks
 Graphic level settings in the settings menu
 Resolution scaling in settings menu
 In solo play, players will take damage from falling rather than killing them outright if they have enough health
 WASD support inside controller input settings menu
 Added a short guard rail for running off the ledge accidentally


Balance Notes

 Remove the launch of bigger enemies with Hammer
 Increase Health gain from defeating enemies Hat
 Performance pass
 Jumping and landing being more reliable 
 Decrease Slows effect on bosses
 Bug Fixes
 Single Player:
 Energy pillar in dungeon refills consistently 
 Frigis dungeon door boss moving out of the arena and getting stuck outside the dungeon
 HUD skill buttons don't update if changed in the controller menu
 Enemies continue to spawn in the tutorial infinitely when the game is in a paused state 
 

Online Multiplayer:

 Enemy doors in mountain biome respawned for both players after defeating Ignis
 Second player's world disappeared when exiting the puzzle dungeon
 Second player turns invisible while the other player is in a cutscene
 Second player cannot see Ignis's Arena and falls into a lava pit
 Frigus ultimate is not going away for the  second player
 Second player sees visual issues with Buff Damage combinations
 Second player received two ultimate skill items after beating the boss
 Enemies who use patrol paths were out of sync
 For the second player, status effects on enemies don't clear right away when defeated
 Second player was able to see crystals when joining another player's game in the tutorial
 Shards spawning after an enemy being defeated did not automatically go to the player


See more bugs? Game updates and bug fixes are ongoing and we’re actively checking bug reports on Bug Report Form

Feel free to join our discord for more communication and updates! 

That's all for now.

Slime on, heroes!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.1
notes.content:
Hello heroes! 

We’ve made the following bug fixes and some balance updates to the game today. Including some big fixes in online multiplayer like:

 Second player getting into a permanent slow state after dodging mid attack
 Second player input freezing while in the pause menu when the other player opens a door
 Second player not accurately showing how many battle dungeons are cleared
 Second player input getting lost after completing certain puzzles in Decoy dungeon
 Second player can collect duplicate tomes collected in previous playthroughs
 Second player obtaining extra hearts when collecting them at the same time as the first player


Balance Notes

 30% health increase for bosses in boss dungeons
 50% damage increase for bosses in boss dungeons
 Can only heal every .2 seconds from the same enemy using skills
 Reduce skill Familiar/Meteor spawns by 1
 Increased the giant snow enemies' health by 20%
 Fire boss health increased by 20%
 Fire boss charge attack damage increased by 110%


Bug Fixes

Single Player:

 Fixed an issue where enemies spawn infinitely in tutorial when the game is paused
 Fixed an issue in the Root dungeon where players didn’t die in water
 Fixed an issue where player SFX weren’t playing after starting a new character
 Mountain enemy door right before the boss respawning after defeating the boss
 Familiar/Meteor skill auto explodes on creation, standing close to bosses
 Final boss floats in the air after using certain attacks
 Decoy dungeon buttons may not activate properly if stepped on and off quickly
 Spider enemy after grabbing the player will permanently stop them from attacking 
 Projectiles no longer go through enemy walls
 Snow boss battle dungeon arena unloading randomly
 Players no longer able to dodge through sand walls in the Desert Biome


Online Multiplayer:

 Boss shards not automatically going to the player instead hanging in the air
 Decoy dungeon doors not opening for both players
 Roll skill not going away on second player death
 Second player getting extra shards that are placed in the world
 Second player able to collect duplicates of hats and damage elements that were collected in previous playthroughs
 Lux bullet blob attack sfx looping forever
 Second player does not see projectile skills exploding FX
 Pazmut audio for completing a dungeon does not seem to play


See more bugs? Game updates and bug fixes are ongoing and we’re actively checking bug reports on Bug Report Form!

Feel free to join our discord for more communication and updates! 

Slime on, heroes!

notes.title: Update - New Release Date for Slime Heroes Announced
notes.content:
We regret to announce that Slime Heroes’  launch on Steam, originally scheduled for February 13, has been unavoidably delayed until Thursday, March 6, 2025. 

We know how excited everyone was about its planned Thursday release, however, in the interest of ensuring that players have the best possible experience, a decision was made to take some extra time to make sure this happens.

We understand the disappointment this news may cause, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this delay may bring to our fans, supporters, and partners. We are doing our best to keep the delay period to a minimum. 

We truly appreciate your continued support, patience, and understanding.

For further updates, be sure to drop Slime Heroes a wishlist and follow the game on Steam, our social channels including Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok, and by joining our official Discord server.

notes.title: Beta Testers Wanted!
notes.content:
We need beta testers!

We are looking for beta testers to play through all of Slime Heroes over the course of two weeks. Some information about the game and your time commitment as a tester:


 Estimated playthrough time: 14 hours
 Beta Test length: 2 weeks
 Tester Age: 18 [years old] or older
 Embargo/NDA: Must be willing to sign an NDA, game's contents are confidential
 Must report bugs and feedback to the designated Beta Tester Discord Channels


If you are interested in signing up for the opportunity to Beta Test, please fill out our interest form here: Slime Heroes Beta Tester Form

Sign ups will close next Friday, June 28th, 2024!

We look forward to your playtesting and feedback. :D

Slime On, Heroes!
